summary: Roads module implemented in src/modules/roads/ (network.js, build.js, materials.js, showcase.js, index.js). world.roads fully implemented: addNode/addEdge (straight or quadratic-bezier via ctrl)/removeEdge/removeNode/nearestEdge/sample/laneCenter/frontage, version bump + roads:changed; extra world.roads.coverage mask + isRoad(x,z). Geometry: per-512 m-tile merged meshes in 4 materials (asphalt / concrete / gravel / paint decals); asphalt_02 PBR with shader-procedural lane markings (dashed centre + dividers, solid edge lines, double solid on avenues, yellow highway inner lines, solid-near-stop-line), wheel-track darkening + polished lane centres, macro colour noise and paint wear; decal pass with zebra crosswalks, stop lines and turn arrows; raised kerbs + concrete sidewalks (concrete_floor_worn_001) with fillet corners (radius per type), mitre/flat corners, T/4-way/Y handling, dead-end caps, joint nodes for gentle bends; alley/street/avenue/highway (+gravel, ramp) widths; highway median Jersey barrier and no sidewalks; ramp merge nodes with acceleration lane taper and the ramp narrowing alongside the carriageway; terrain-conforming smoothed height profiles with node heights from the profiles, cut/fill via dense terrain flatten brushes, gravel embankment skirts; bridges over water (deck, parapets, side beams, underside, piers with caps). API: rebuild(), lampPositions(edgeId), intersections(), nodeInfo(), stats(), edges()/edgeDebug(). Showcase: 5x5 grid + avenue + alleys + crosswalk crossroads, one-way loop, S-curved highway with on-ramp merge, street bridge over the river, presets intersection/highway/bridge/loop/merge/corner/kerb. Manifest: appended concrete_floor_worn_001 and gravel_floor_02 (Poly Haven CC0), fetched. Final gauntlet rdev1: 16/16 ok, max drawCalls 57 (total scene incl. terrain+environment; budget 80), max triangles 339,814, 0 console errors, module status ready everywhere; 7 shots had to be re-taken individually because page.screenshot timed out (30 s) under SwiftShader load or captured Vite full-reloads caused by other builders. SwiftShader fps reads 0 with terrain present (frames > 1.5 s, terrain-dominated); roads alone on a flat world measured 12.7 fps vs the 11.6 fps empty baseline.
